name: Default
shortDescription: Memory server for stateful AI agents: a FastAPI API and background deriver that reason over stored messages, backed by PostgreSQL with pgvector and Redis.

alerts.message: Set LLM_OPENAI_API_KEY to an OpenAI API key and redeploy: memory extraction, summaries, dialectic chat and embeddings all need it. To use another OpenAI-compatible provider instead, also set the per-feature model and base URL variables described in the configuration docs.
JWT authentication is on. Mint an admin token by running python scripts/generate_jwt.py --admin in the honcho container terminal, then pass it as the API key in the SDK or as a Bearer header.
